title: English Practice Quiz 0791
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Interview Skills 01: Before an interview, a candidate should?
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: research the organisation and role.

questions.question: Interview Skills 02: A strong example-based answer should explain?
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: the situation, action and result.

questions.question: Interview Skills 03: If a question is unclear, a candidate should?
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: politely ask for clarification.

questions.question: Interview Skills 04: A suitable interview greeting is?
questions.explanation: Option B is correct: polite and confident.

questions.question: Interview Skills 05: A CV should contain?
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: relevant experience and accurate details.

questions.question: Interview Skills 06: When discussing a weakness, mention?
options: a genuine area you are improving
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: a genuine area you are improving.

questions.question: Interview Skills 07: If an interview is delayed, you should?
options: wait professionally and request an update if appropriate
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: wait professionally and request an update if appropriate.

questions.question: Interview Skills 08: An appropriate question at the end concerns?
options: the main priorities of the role
questions.explanation: Option B is correct: the main priorities of the role.

questions.question: Interview Skills 09: A candidate should arrive?
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: on time and prepared.

questions.question: Interview Skills 10: A brief post-interview message should?
options: thank the interviewer for their time
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: thank the interviewer for their time.
